testimonials.name: Sarah M.
testimonials.text: My laptop wouldn't turn on and I assumed it was dead for good. They diagnosed a bad charging port, fixed it same week, and everything I had on it was safe. Honest, fast, and easy to work with.

testimonials.name: James R.
testimonials.text: Had them build a custom PC for video editing. They walked me through every part choice and explained things in plain English instead of talking over my head. Runs perfectly.

testimonials.name: Denise K.
testimonials.text: Came out to my house to fix our Wi-Fi and set up a new printer the same afternoon I called. Saved me a trip and a headache.

testimonials.name: Mike T.
testimonials.text: Thought I needed a brand new computer. They refurbished my old desktop with an SSD and more RAM instead, for a fraction of the cost. Feels brand new.
